name: Perils of the Warp
description: Black Crusade, Table 6-3 (p. 211). Rolled on a result of 75+ on Psychic Phenomena. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.name: The Gibbering
results.text: Psyker: Challenging (+0) Willpower Test or Stunned for [[1d5]] rounds.

results.name: Warp Burn
results.text: Psyker takes [[2d5]] Damage ignoring Toughness Bonus and armour, and is Stunned for [[1d5]] rounds.

results.name: Psychic Concussion
results.text: Psyker is knocked Unconscious for [[1d5]] rounds. Everyone within [[3d10]] metres: Routine (+10) Willpower Test or Stunned for one round.

results.name: Psy Blast
results.text: Psyker is thrown [[3d10]] metres into the air and takes Falling Damage for the distance.

results.name: Soul Sear
results.text: Psyker may use no powers for one hour and gains [[2d5]] Corruption Points.

results.name: Locked In
results.text: Psyker falls catatonic. Each round he may spend a Full Action on a Difficult (-10) Willpower Test; a success ends the effect.

results.name: Chronological Incontinence
results.text: Psyker vanishes and returns in the same spot after [[1d10]] rounds. He takes 1 permanent Toughness Damage, 1 permanent Intelligence Damage, and gains [[1d5]] Corruption Points.

results.name: Psychic Mirror
results.text: The power resolves against the psyker instead. If the power is beneficial, he takes [[1d10+5]] Energy Damage ignoring armour instead.

results.name: Warp Whispers
results.text: Everyone within [[4d10]] metres, psyker included: Hard (-20) Willpower Test or gain [[1d5]] Corruption Points and equal Willpower Damage. The psyker takes a further [[1d5+5]] Willpower Damage regardless.

results.name: Vice Versa
results.text: Psyker swaps consciousness with a random non-soulless creature within 50 metres for [[1d10]] rounds; each keeps WS, BS, Int, Per, WP and Fel, and takes [[1d5]] Intelligence Damage. With no creature in range he falls catatonic for [[1d5]] rounds and takes [[1d10]] Willpower Damage, [[1d10]] Intelligence Damage and [[1d10]] Corruption Points.

results.name: Dark Summoning
results.text: A Bloodletter appears within [[3d10]] metres for [[1d5]] rounds plus its Toughness Bonus. The psyker's turn ends immediately; the daemon acts at once and attacks only the psyker.

results.name: Rending the Veil
results.text: For [[1d5]] rounds, all creatures with an Intelligence characteristic within [[1d100]] metres test against Fear (2); the psyker tests against Fear (4).

results.name: Blood Rain
results.text: Everyone within [[5d10]] metres: Challenging (+0) Strength Test or knocked Prone. For [[1d5]] rounds any power used in the area invokes Perils of the Warp in addition to any Phenomena. Psyker gains [[1d5+1]] Corruption Points.

results.name: Cataclysmic Blast
results.text: Everyone within [[1d10]] metres, psyker included, takes [[1d10+8]] Energy Damage with Pen 5. The psyker may not Dodge it or use a Field save. His gear is destroyed and he may use no powers for [[1d5]] hours.

results.name: Mass Possession
results.text: Every character within [[1d100]] metres resists a possession attack by a random Lesser Daemon (Possession Trait). Lasts up to [[2d10]] rounds.

results.name: Reality Quake
results.text: Everything within [[3d10]] metres takes [[2d10]] Rending Damage, ignoring armour and undodgeable. Warded objects, daemons and untouchables halve it.

results.name: Grand Possession
results.text: A Greater Daemon attempts to possess the psyker (Possession Trait). Win or lose, he takes [[2d10]] Toughness Damage and permanently adds +10 to all Psychic Phenomena and Perils rolls. If he dies possessed, the daemon manifests for days equal to its Toughness Bonus.
